metadata.description: Two skills, one house style: explain-the-fix diagrams a just-finished coding task (bug fix, refactor, new feature) instead of a wall of text, and visualize-the-plan diagrams a proposed plan before you build it. Built for vibe coders who lose track of what an AI agent changed or is about to change. Renders self-contained dark-mode-default HTML/SVG diagrams with a clickable glossary for jargon.
